example: Constructive mediation between employers and unions frequently achieves a favourable outcome without disruptive strikes.

meaningVi: tác động/định đoạt kết quả của
example: Access to quiet home study spaces can significantly influence the outcome of high-stakes secondary examinations.

l1Traps.whyVi: Thừa "out"; chuẩn là "determine/shape the outcome of".

example: Severe housing shortages are an inevitable outcome when cities restrict residential construction for decades.

l1Traps.whyVi: Rườm rà; chuẩn là "an inevitable outcome".

meaningVi: đạt được/mang lại một kết quả
example: Integrated community care programmes often achieve an outcome that is both healthier and less costly for taxpayers.

l1Traps.whyVi: Sai động từ; chuẩn là "achieve/yield/deliver an outcome".

example: Needs-based school funding is designed to promote more equitable outcomes across urban and rural districts.

l1Traps.whyVi: Kém chuẩn hơn "equitable outcomes".
